author: Good Enough
description:
A volcanic eruption can become deadly fast, with lava, ash, toxic gases, and flying debris creating multiple dangers at once. Knowing when to evacuate, where to take shelter, and how to protect yourself from ash and dangerous gases can greatly improve your chances of survival.

This Short explains how to survive a volcanic eruption, what to do if a volcano erupts, how to avoid volcanic ash and lava hazards, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during a volcanic emergency.
title: How to Survive a Volcanic Eruption 🌋⚠️ #volcano #naturaldisaster #survival #outdoors
